name: StreamableContent
description: Content that arrives over time, such as a generated summary, with waiting, streaming, done, error and stopped states. Livewire streams into it with wire:stream; Stop is always available while streaming, and partial content stays when a stream fails.

livewire.name: streamable-content
capabilities: wire:stream (Livewire 4; Livewire 3 renders the content statically)
differences: Livewire only (D-003): built on wire:stream. React and Vue would need a different transport, and nothing downstream asks for one.
The 2.x props tag, prose, placeholder and showCursor are gone: the state draws the status, the caret and the waiting skeleton.

props.name: target
props.description: The wire:stream target the component streams to with $this->stream( to: … ).

props.name: state
props.description: Where the stream is. Emitted as data-state. Waiting shows skeleton lines until the first words; streaming shows the caret and Stop; error and stopped keep the partial content.

props.name: status
props.description: The status line's text. Defaults to the state's, translated: Waiting for a response…, Writing…, Done, The response was interrupted. or Stopped.

props.name: stopLabel
props.description: The Stop button's text. Translate it: defaults through __( 'Stop' ).

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons under the content, such as Copy and Regenerate when done, or Continue after an error.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { status: '…', content: '…' }.

parts.name: status
parts.description: A line saying what's happening (role=status), with the state's icon or indicator.

parts.name: stopTrigger
parts.description: The Stop button at the end of the status line, while streaming. Dispatches stop.

parts.name: content
parts.description: The live region (aria-live=polite, aria-busy while waiting or streaming) that wire:stream writes to.

parts.name: caret
parts.description: The blinking caret after the text while streaming, hidden from assistive technology.

events.name: stop
events.description: The Stop button was pressed: wire:stop="cancel" or x-on:stop.

keyboard.action: Reaches Stop while streaming, then the actions.

requirements: The content is aria-live=polite and aria-busy while waiting or streaming, so it isn't re-announced token by token; the status line is role=status.
Stop is always available while streaming.
Partial content stays when a stream fails, with an action to continue.
The caret is aria-hidden and stops blinking under reduced motion; no sparkle icons or gradients.

fixture.content: Revenue grew 10.9% month over month, led by Lakeview Lofts and Golden Hour Apartments.
